card.name: Linking words before contraceptive hormone names
card.fires_on: Small verbs and linking words (affect, in, of, reduced, the) right before an oral contraceptive hormone such as ethinyl estradiol, levonorgestrel or gestodene. Seen in drug interaction text about changed exposure or AUC.

modes.label: Verb before hormone
modes.description: A verb of change such as affect, reduced or increases that comes just before a contraceptive hormone name.
modes.example: but did not<< affect>> the systemic exposure to ethinylestr

modes.label: In/of after decrease or AUC
modes.description: The word in or of after decrease or AUC, leading into a hormone name.
modes.example: Felbamate treatment resulted in a 42% decrease<< in>> the gestodene AUC 0

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model to write a hormone name such as ethinyl estradiol or levonorgestrel next.
card.plain: It marks the small word just before a contraceptive hormone is named in a drug interaction sentence.
